2a6bf50fe605.en: Prologue subchapter 2: the old scientist works glowing light around his arm over the carcass while the silver-haired man watches, arms crossed.
2a6bf50fe605.t: Prolog subbab 2: ilmuwan tua itu menggerakkan cahaya berpendar di sekitar lengannya di atas bangkai, sementara pria berambut perak mengamati sambil bersedekap.
